neighbours.label: A quantity inside a distributive or per-unit construction (each speaks two lines, three events each year, a few at a time, four cups of)
fire: Each runner gets two bottles at the start.
We hold four meetings each year at the office.
They let in a few at a time through the gate.
Each child reads three lines in the play.
She drinks two cups of tea every morning.
The team runs five drills each week.
The guards check two bags per person.
He takes one pill at a time with water.
quiet: The runner got a medal at the finish.
We held the meeting at the office last year.
They let in the dog through the gate.
The child read the play aloud.
She drinks tea in the garden.
The team ran drills on the new field.
The guards check the doors at night.
He takes the bus to work with Jan.

notes: Registered as a dispute: the card is mixed ('grand jury of', a French ball|on) and mostly gate-closed, so I expect the distributive reading not to hold on fresh sentences. Not probed.
